title: Respond constructively without promising an unapproved remedy
prompt:
Customer is angry about a missed delivery. You can acknowledge the delay and promise a status check tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Refunds are not authorized. Choose a response: A=Calm down; this is your fault. B=I understand the missed delivery disrupted your plans. I will update you tomorrow at 10:00 UTC after checking its status. C=We will refund everything immediately.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. selected: A, B, or C.
remediation_hints: Acknowledge impact and give an owned next step within actual authority.
